value.subject: URGENT: Critical Parts Shortage - M1 Abrams Tank Fleet Readiness
value.bodyPreview: Sir, we have identified a critical shortage of transmission components for the M1A2 Abrams fleet affecting 23% of operational vehicles across FORSCOM units...

body.content:
Sir,

We have identified a critical shortage of transmission components for the M1A2 Abrams fleet affecting 23% of operational vehicles across FORSCOM units.

Current Situation:

  • 168 tanks deadlined for X1100-3B transmission assemblies
  • Current supply on hand: 42 units (12-week backorder from contractor)
  • Impacts 3rd Armored Brigade Combat Team readiness below 80%
  • Projected to affect an additional 94 vehicles within 45 days

Immediate Actions Required:

  • Authorize emergency procurement authority for expedited production run
  • Coordinate with Anniston Army Depot for priority rebuild capacity
  • Brief FORSCOM G4 on timeline and mitigation strategy

Detailed supply analysis and recommended COA attached. Request decision by 20 NOV to maintain Q1 readiness targets.

Respectfully,
BG Marcus Williams
Deputy Commander for Logistics
TACOM Life Cycle Management Command
